project: The Heat Exchange - NTU Clifton Campus

rooms.name: Entrance Atrium & Cafe
rooms.use: Double-height glazed entrance facing the campus, cafe and reception counter.
notes: Atrium + opening rooflights drive stack ventilation in summer
Full-height glazing on the south-west corner, shaded by the 1.2 m slab overhang

items.sustainability_note: Demand-controlled ventilation; feeds the digital twin
Switches/dims lights to occupancy and daylight

rooms.name: WCs (incl. accessible)
rooms.use: Accessible WC plus two cubicles; stacked under the first-floor WCs.
notes: Rainwater harvested from the roof flushes the WCs
Stacked wet rooms = short drainage runs and cheaper plumbing

items.spec: Vanity with 2 basins, sensor taps, 4 l/min

Switches/dims lights to occupancy and daylight

rooms.name: Flexible Teaching Hall
rooms.use: 48-seat flat-floor teaching space, reconfigurable for events.
notes: South windows sit below the overhang: summer sun blocked, winter sun admitted
CO2-controlled ventilation ramps up only when the room is full

items.sustainability_note: Demand-controlled ventilation; feeds the digital twin
Switches/dims lights to occupancy and daylight

rooms.name: Makerspace
rooms.use: 3D printing, electronics and prototyping benches.

items.sustainability_note: Demand-controlled ventilation; feeds the digital twin

rooms.name: Plant Room
rooms.use: Water-source heat pump, thermal store, battery, MVHR and rainwater pumps.
notes: Placed directly beside the server room so recovered heat travels metres, not tens of metres

items.sustainability_note: Stores midday PV for evening use
Upgrades server waste heat to 45-55 C
Switches/dims lights to occupancy and daylight

rooms.name: Edge Server Room
rooms.use: Small edge data centre whose waste heat feeds the heat pump and heats the building.
notes: North side: no solar gain to remove
Hot-aisle heat captured by rear-door heat exchangers
Surplus heat can be exported to neighbouring campus buildings

items.spec: Links rear-door heat exchangers to the heat pump

items.sustainability_note: Switches/dims lights to occupancy and daylight
